subject: executor, planner: fix indexLookUp with static pruning (#44139)
summary: Diff vs parent gates the extra index-scan output column (pid/physical table id) to cases that actually need it (global index, or dynamic partition prune + embedded-limit order path), aligning `executor/builder.go`’s `buildIndexReq` output offsets with `IndexLookUpExecutor.hasExtralPidCol()` expectations and avoiding static-prune column-count mismatches. Added regression tests cover static prune for IndexLookUp + order-by/limit (#44123); no remaining Blocker/High issues found in the touched planner/executor paths.
